Project overview

The client runs a local business that provides home services. From the beginning, this SEO case study had three goals: to raise the rankings of important service keywords, to fix keyword targeting gaps to improve search visibility, and to raise conversions by identifying and acting on rank movement trends. All of our plans were based on those three goals.

Setting up the Rank Tracker is part of the strategy.

We made a set of keywords for our Rank Tracker tool that includes service terms, location intent, and competitor keywords. Weekly tracking with drop alerts made sure that every movement was clear and accountable. Reporting included keyword movement for the Top 3, Top 10, and Top 20, so nothing went unnoticed.

Plan for optimizing the website

We started by building a full keyword set across primary service terms, geo-modifiers, and competitor gaps. Next came position benchmarking, which included baseline rankings across all main service pages before any work began. Then came ongoing monitoring, which included weekly rank reports, movement alerts, and competitor comparison to keep the campaign on track at every stage.

PROJECT OVERVIEW

The client runs a local business that provides home services. From the beginning, this SEO case study had three goals: to raise the rankings of important service keywords, to fix technical SEO problems to make crawling and indexing better, and to raise conversions by making the site faster and easier to use. All of our plans were based on those three goals.

Setting up the Rank Tracker is part of the strategy.

We made a set of keywords for our Rank Tracker tool that includes service terms, location intent, and competitor keywords. Weekly tracking with drop alerts made sure that every movement was clear and accountable. Reporting included keyword movement for the Top 3, Top 10, and Top 20, so nothing went unnoticed.

Plan for optimizing the website

We started with technical SEO, fixing problems with indexing, redirects, canonical tags, and sitemaps. Next came on-page signals, which included titles, H1 and H2 structure, and internal linking on all of the main service pages. Next came speed optimization, which included compressing images, cleaning up JS and CSS, and using caching to raise Core Web Vitals scores to a competitive level.

SEO Audit & Reporting Work

What we made better

Technical SEO included setting up canonical tags, redirects, indexing, and crawl fixes, as well as sitemaps and robots. On-page SEO took care of things like titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal linking, and full content mapping on service pages.

The main focus of Core Web Vitals work was fixing LCP and CLS issues, compressing images, caching, and cleaning up JS and CSS. Schema implementation added organization, a FAQ, a service schema, and breadcrumbs to make search results even more visible.

Local SEO included setting up a Google Business Profile, making sure your NAP is consistent, getting citations, and making a plan for reviews. To turn more visitors into leads, Conversion UX improvements made CTAs, trust blocks, form simplicity, and service page clarity better.

What This SEO Case Study Will Give You

We give each client a full SEO audit report that includes a priority roadmap, a plan for keyword research, and a plan for content clusters. All of the important service pages are fixed on-page, and then full technical SEO is put into place right away.

Performance optimization takes care of speed and Core Web Vitals directly. A Rank Tracker dashboard with weekly reports keeps everyone involved in the campaign up to date.
